verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration-services SaaS platform, and such a platform could plausibly publish an API, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only guided intake flows, eligibility checkers, and fee calculators, with no API reference or runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
